status.label: Bounded Keyboard Manager enhancement
status.detail: The requested drag-to-reorder interaction maps to existing ordered mapping collections and persistence.

next_action.label: Complete reorder design
next_action.reason: Define whether order is presentation-only or affects mapping precedence, then specify persistence and accessibility behavior.

judgment.rationale: The screenshots and scenario define a concrete interaction, and current code has identifiable list and persistence structures that can support a scoped design.
evidence: The request asks for left-button drag-and-drop reordering of Keyboard Manager rows.
The editor displays mappings through ListView controls bound to ObservableCollection instances.
Mapping order is loaded from ShortcutsByOperationType ID lists, so durable reordering must update persisted order.
judgment.recommended_action: Prepare an implementation-grade design for accessible row reordering and canonical order persistence across mapping categories.

issue_context.summary: Keyboard Manager users cannot rearrange existing mapping rows and want direct drag-and-drop ordering.
known_information: The report supplies before-and-after screenshots and describes mouse drag behavior.
MainPage.xaml uses ListView controls for remappings, text mappings, program shortcuts, URL shortcuts, and disabled mappings.
MainPage.xaml.cs reconstructs each collection from persisted operation-specific ID order.
inferences: A reorder operation will need to update both the visible ObservableCollection and the underlying persisted ID list.
Keyboard-only and assistive-technology alternatives may be required because pointer-only dragging is not sufficient accessibility coverage.
issue_context.analysis: The request is specific enough for design, but approval would be premature until ordering semantics, persistence boundaries, and accessible controls are defined.
initial_investigation: Confirmed there is no current row-reorder handler in the editor.

information_gaps.information: Whether row order is purely organizational or establishes conflict precedence
information_gaps.why_needed: This determines whether the change is UI-only or modifies runtime mapping resolution semantics.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Resolve as a maintainer product and engine-design decision before implementation.
